domains.name: Event Show Operations
domains.scope: Prepare caller cue sheets and rehearse alternate presentation delivery and program rejoin decisions.

skills.name: show-cue-and-standby-sheet
skills.description: Turn an event rundown into a callable sheet that separates standby, release, acknowledgment, and audience-visible completion.

skills.name: alternate-playback-recovery-rehearsal
skills.description: Build a rehearsal script for a failed presentation cue that identifies an approved alternate, the switch decision, and a verified rejoin point.
